findings.suggested_fix: Track whether the draft was started as an edit and retain its source rule identity/version. Clear or reject an edit draft if that source disappears during reset/plan restoration; reconcile external enabled changes when saving instead of replacing the entire current rule with the stale snapshot. Add regression coverage for edit→disable→save and edit→reset/load-plan→save.
findings.title: Invalidate research drafts when their source rule changes
findings.why_it_matters: An open research editor can silently restore an obsolete condition after Reset All or loading another saved plan. Workbench stays mounted while navigating, so its draft survives; when the original rule ID disappears, Save appends the old draft into the replacement rules. Editing a rule and then disabling its visible checkbox also saves the draft's old enabled=true value back over the checkbox change. Track the source rule separately and invalidate or reconcile that draft when its live rule changes, rather than treating a missing edited rule as a newly created one.

residual_risks: Greedy replay has substantial computation cost at the supported interactive scale: a non-mutating Node benchmark of backtest(input, 30), using 500 deterministic dated records and one greedy rule with defaultResearch settings (100-record window, 3 folds, 57 candidates), took 23,790 ms and returned 30 evaluable results; the same replay with BMA took 585 ms. This is a measured latency tradeoff, not a contract violation: full-universe rolling fitting is explicitly required, and Backtest runs it in a terminable Worker. The 200-period UI option and browser/device latency were not measured.
testing_gaps: Add an end-to-end replay regression for a non-uniform scoring model with seeded ranking and a future outcome chosen to differ from the past-only selection; existing replay integration exercises hotcold only, while the complete-universe integration ranking test uses an entirely uniform model.

tests/replay-worker-ui.test.tsx:47-65 exercises only cancelled and obsolete jobs. Add one completed replay asserting displayed retained/removed rows and a worker error reply asserting the alert and restored run button; otherwise regressions in the newly added rows/error response handling in src/components/Backtest.tsx:64-70 escape this suite.
